name: Fun Times at Homer´s
summary: A new diner has open it doors in Springfield going by “Simpsons Happy Donuts”. And it’s owner made partnership with Professor Frink to create the best robots A.I.s, outstanding other diners in town. But as a favor, Frink wanted to test his new subject "Security Couch" so every moonrise 12am to 6am the robots would turn aggressive towards Security Couch as a Artificial Intelligence test. The company accepted the favor, and You are the couch, will You make it far?
